what: hir now has `AnyDiagnostic::UnplacedDiagnostic(Box<hir::UnplacedDiagnostic>)` (crates/hir/src/diagnostics.rs): a diagnostic in desugared code that hir used to drop (inference, missing unsafe, borrowck, const check). `lower` in crates/blaze-diagnostics/src/lower/mod.rs matches AnyDiagnostic exhaustively, so it needs the arm now or the crate stops compiling: `AnyDiagnostic::UnplacedDiagnostic(d) => unplaced_diagnostic::lower(cx, &d),` plus `pub(crate) mod unplaced_diagnostic;` with: `pub(crate) fn lower(cx: &Cx<'_, '_>, d: &hir::UnplacedDiagnostic<'_>) -> Vec<Found> { let node = cx.syntax_view(d.owner); let span = cx.span(node.map(|it| it.text_range())); let what = match &d.what { hir::Unplaced::Inference(it) => format!("type checking's {it:?}"), hir::Unplaced::MissingUnsafe { reason, lint } => format!("{reason:?} ({lint:?}) needs `unsafe`"), hir::Unplaced::Borrowck { code, message } | hir::Unplaced::ConstCheck { code, message } => format!("{code}: {message}") }; vec![Found::new(Diag::error(None, format!("blaze: {what}, in code with no syntax of its own, which blaze cannot place"), span), Phase::Bodies)] }` (an error always: no-fallback; it is blaze's own, never rustc's). Imports as in lower/val_tree_error.rs.
